labels.employeeMain: PIFSS employee share (8%, up to KWD 2,750)
labels.noDeductions: No social security deduction for expatriates

notes.kuwaiti: Kuwaiti employees in the private sector pay 8% of contributory salary up to KWD 2,750, plus 2.5% up to KWD 1,500. Contributions are calculated on at least KWD 230. Employers pay 11.5%. Kuwait has no personal income tax.
notes.expat: Expatriate workers do not pay social security in Kuwait, and there is no personal income tax, so net salary equals gross salary. Expatriates receive an end-of-service indemnity instead.
notes.disclaimer: Estimate only. Rates are based on published private-sector PIFSS rules and can change. Check with PIFSS or your employer for your exact deduction.
